requires.n: Cards Allowing a Creature to Tap for Free

requires.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Academy Manufactor, or previously used to create a copy

390-1486-4231-4452--108--119.description:
Use the permanent that allows you to tap creatures for free to tap two untapped creatures you control.
Magda triggers twice due to Rukarumel, creating six Treasure tokens, six Food tokens, and six three Clue tokens.
Activate Magda by sacrificing five Treasures, searching your library for Hulking Metamorph. If this is a clone effect, have it copy Academy Manufactor.
Use the permanent that allows you to tap creatures for free to tap an untapped creature you control.
Magda triggers due to Rukarumel, creating at least six Treasure tokens, at least three Food tokens, and at least three Clue tokens.
Activate Magda by sacrificing five Treasures, searching your library for any creature and putting it onto the battlefield.
Repeat from step 4.
Once you have sufficient excess Treasure tokens, you may activate Magda additional times to search your library for noncreature artifacts and put them onto the battlefield.

751-4289-8201.description:
Cast Shrieking Drake by paying {U}.
When Shrieking Drake enters, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Shrieking Drake by tapping it, adding {U}.
Resolve the Shrieking Drake ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

116-2645-3430-3664.easyPrerequisites: Kiora's Follower doesn't have summoning sickness.
116-2645-3430-3664.description:
Activate Lotus Field by tapping it, adding nine mana of any color due to Nyxbloom Ancient
Activate Kiora's Follower by tapping it, untapping Lotus Field
Activate Staff of Domination's third ability by paying {3} and tapping it, untapping Kiora's Follower.
Activate Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat.

1661-1879-5078-8171.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
Vraska triggers, creating a 1/1 Sculpture Treasure artifact creature token.
Activate the token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

215-3480-5457.notablePrerequisites: You control at least seven creatures with different powers.
215-3480-5457.description:
Activate Selvala by tapping it, adding an amount of {G} or {W}.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Selvala from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Selvala by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.
215-3480-5457.notes: Alternate the colors of mana you add each time. If you start adding {W}, you need {G} for Temur Sabertooth and {G} to cast Selvala

1618-4377-7757.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature that can attack and that cannot be blocked or killed by an opponent.
1618-4377-7757.description:
Declare any creature as an attacker. When you do, Doom's Time Platform triggers, exiling Walk the Aeons from your graveyard with two time counters on it.
Activate The Tenth Doctor by paying {7}, removing the time counters from Walk the Aeons.
Walk the Aeons's suspend ability triggers, causing you to cast it without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Walk the Aeons, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

1274-4268-7690--165.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
1274-4268-7690--165.description:
Gain life.
Heliod triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the other Hero.
Invisible Woman triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Kor Celebrant triggers, causing you to gain life.
Repeat from step 2.

2060-3490-7343-7363.description:
Activate a Mutagen by paying {0} due to Mutagen Man, tapping and sacrificing it, putting a +1/+1 counter on Crystalline Crawler.
Animation Module triggers. Holding priority, activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {1}.
Resolve the Animation Module trigger, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token and a Mutagen token.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more charge counters on it

1563-3899-4365-6633.description:
Activate Spawning Pit's second ability by paying {1} and removing two charge counters from it, creating two creature tokens
Activate the tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Activate Spawning Pit's first ability twice by sacrificing the tokens, putting two charge counters on Spawning Pit.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with Mirror Room locked and Fractured Realm unlocked

950-4359-5921-5970.description:
Activate Marina by tapping it, unlocking Mirror Room.
Mirror Room triggers twice due to Fractured Realm, creating two token copies of Fatestitcher.
Activate one of the Fatestitcher tokens by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Activate Marina by tapping it, locking Mirror Room.
Activate the other Fatestitcher token by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Repeat.

2086-2921-6824.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Kitchen Finks.
When Kitchen Finks dies, its persist ability triggers, returning Kitchen Finks from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Kitchen Finks enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to gain 2 life.
Spider-Man triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Kitchen Finks.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Repeat.

2724-3194-3582-6797.description:
Activate Kaya the Inexorable's first ability by putting a loyalty counter on it, putting a ghostform counter on Wormfang Manta.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Wormfang Manta.
When Wormfang Manta dies, its second ability and its ghostform ability trigger.
Resolve the ghostform trigger, returning Wormfang Manta from your graveyard to your hand and creating a 1/1 Spirit creature token.
Resolve the second trigger, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability
Cast Wormfang Manta by paying {5}{U}{U}.
Wormfang Manta's first ability does not trigger due to Hushwing Gryff.
Repeat each turn.

777-1690-2538-5034.notablePrerequisites: You have an artifact card in hand that can be cast for {0} due to Foundry Inspector.
777-1690-2538-5034.description:
Activate Sol Ring by tapping it, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Words of Wind by paying {1}.
Cast an artifact by paying {0}.
Jhoira triggers, causing each player to return a permanent they control from the battlefield to their hand due to Words of Wind, with you returning Sol Ring to your hand.
Activate Words of Wind by paying {1}.
Cast Sol Ring by paying {0}.
Jhoira triggers, causing each player to return a permanent they control from the battlefield to their hand due to Words of Wind, with you returning the artifact cast in step 3 to your hand.
Repeat.
777-1690-2538-5034.notes: You can use an artifact creature to get infinite ETB and LTB triggers. If you do not use a creature, this combo will not produce those results.

2743-5461-6441.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block and kill creatures you control.
2743-5461-6441.description:
Activate Calamity's saddle ability by tapping Biovisionary, causing Calamity to become saddled until end of turn.
Declare Calamity as an attacker.
Calamity triggers, creating four token copies of Biovisionary that are tapped and attacking.
At the beginning of your end step, Calamity triggers four times and each Biovisionary triggers.
Resolve the first Biovisionary trigger, causing you to win the game.

uses.n: Emet-Selch, Unsundered // Hades, Sorcerer of Eld

4872-6333-6335.manaNeeded: {1}{W} plus enough mana to cast the extra turn spell each turn
4872-6333-6335.easyPrerequisites: Robe of Stars attached to Hades.
4872-6333-6335.description:
Cast Time Warp from your graveyard by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, activate Robe of Stars by paying {1}{W}, phasing out Hades.
Resolve Time Warp, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
During your extra turn, Hades phases in during your untap step.
Repeat.

413-2523-5401.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Bilbo.
When Bilbo dies, Ratadrabik triggers, creating a nonlegendary token copy of Bilbo that is a 2/2 Zombie.
When the Bilbo token enters the battlefield, it and Blasting Station trigger.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Bilbo trigger, causing the Ring to tempt you, with the Bilbo token becoming your Ring-bearer.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 1.
Repeat.

913-1912-4222-5516.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent controls a creature.
Red Death does not have summoning sickness.
Freed from the Real attached to Red Death.
913-1912-4222-5516.description:
Activate Red Death by tapping it, adding {R}, goading a creature an opponent controls and causing that opponent to draw a card.
Activate Signpost Scarecrow by paying {1}, adding {U}.
Activate Freed from the Real by paying {U}, untapping Red Death.
Repeat.

1947-4871-5258-5618.description:
Activate Reckless Barbarian by sacrificing it, adding {R}{R}.
When Reckless Barbarian dies, Pitiless Plunderer and Rakdos trigger.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Holding priority, activate Haunted Crossroads by paying {B}, putting Reckless Barbarian from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Rakdos trigger, exiling the top two cards of your library, including Reckless Barbarian, with the ability to cast them until your next turn.
Cast Reckless Barbarian from exile by paying {1}{R}.
Repeat.

2985-3489-3542.notablePrerequisites:
Dokuchi Silencer does not have summoning sickness and cannot be blocked by an opponent.
You control up to seven lands that can tap to produce at least {3}{U}{B}{B}.
2985-3489-3542.description:
Declare Dokuchi Silencer as an attacker.
When it isn't blocked, activate up to seven lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {3}{U}{B}{B}.
Activate Palinchron's ninjutsu ability by paying {2}{U}{B} and returning Dokuchi Silencer from the battlefield to your hand, putting Palinchron onto the battlefield from your hand tapped and attacking.
When Palinchron enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping up to seven lands.
Activate Dokuchi Silencer's ninjutsu ability by paying {1}{B} and returning Palinchron from the battlefield to your hand, putting Dokuchi Silencer onto the battlefield from your hand tapped and attacking.
Repeat from step 2.
If you control up to seven lands that can tap to produce at least {4}{U}{B}{B}, this combo nets infinite mana.

1734-4681-5231.description:
Cast Fiend Hunter by paying its mana cost.
When Fiend Hunter enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Karmic Guide.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Fiend Hunter.
When Fiend Hunter dies, its second ability triggers, returning Karmic Guide from exile to the battlefield.
When Karmic Guide enters, it triggers, returning Fiend Hunter from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Fiend Hunter enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Karmic Guide.
Repeat from step 3.

969-2906-3100-3371.notablePrerequisites:
Codie does not have summoning sickness.You have at least two opponents.
Opponents have lost at least 3 life this turn plus an additional 2 life for each time you've cast Codie from the command zone this game, minus 1 life for each opponent you have beyond the second.
969-2906-3100-3371.description:
Activate Codie by paying {4} and tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}.
Activate Lampad of Death's Vigil by paying {1} and sacrificing Codie.
Choose to return Codie to the command zone from your graveyard.
Resolve the Lampad of Death's Vigil trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Cast Codie from the command zone by paying {0} due to Rakdos.
Repeat.
NOTE: This combo ends once you have one opponent remaining, as the lifeloss from Lampad of Death's Vigil no longer covers Codie's increased commander tax.
However, you may be able to get more iterations if you started the combo with three or more opponents, as Rakdos will decrease Codie's cost by {3}, outpacing the {2} from commander tax, until you have two or less opponents.
 Once you have a large number of Codie triggers, you may cast any instant or sorcery by paying its mana cost.
Codie triggers for each time you activated its ability.
Resolve the first trigger, causing you to exile cards from the top of your library until you exile an instant or sorcery spell with lesser mana value, and allowing you to cast that spell without paying its mana cost.
Repeat step 11 for each remaining trigger.

uses.n: You See a Pair of Goblins

647-827-1328-3259.notablePrerequisites:
Breath of Fury and Spellbinder attached to different creatures you control.
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
647-827-1328-3259.description:
Deal combat damage to an opponent using the creatures that have Spellbinder and Breath of Fury attached.
Spellbinder and Breath of Fury trigger.
Resolve the Spellbinder trigger, casting a copy of You See a Pair of Goblins without paying its mana cost.
Resolve the copy of You See a Pair of Goblins, creating two 1/1 Goblin creature tokens.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, attach Breath of Fury to a Goblin token, untap all creatures you control and get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

1933-4191.description:
Cast Aether Adept without paying its mana cost due to Aluren.
When Aether Adept enters, it triggers, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

739-1173-5261.notablePrerequisites:
You have Gideon of the Trials's emblem.
You control a Gideon planeswalker.
739-1173-5261.description:
Activate Isochron Scepter by paying {2}, casting a copy of Final Fortune without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Final Fortune, taking an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.
At the beginning of each extra turn's end step, Final Fortune triggers to cause you to lose the game, but you cannot lose the game due to Gideon of the Trials's emblem.
